rows.to: basalt({ app: { name, icons, seo, manifest, serviceWorker } }) from basalt-ui/vite
rows.note: basalt() absorbs the head plugin: the theme script replaces the anti-FOUC style and the bootScript, colorScheme and backgroundColor paint options; icons take only the explicit list (the six-file default and { dir } are gone); themeColor moves to the top level
rows.verify: vite build: index.html carries the theme script once, no <style>, and site.webmanifest when app is set

rows.note: the 2.x text guard is deleted in 3.0, with its `basalt.severity`, `exempt`, `exemptRules` and `include` config keys; instead: `basalt-ui lint` and the oxlint and stylelint presets, which also read the app's own waivers

the 2.x PreToolUse theme-guard adapter is deleted in 3.0; instead: the editor hook `.basalt/hook.mjs` (`basalt-ui lint --hook`), placed by `basalt-ui init` and `sync`; remove the old `guard-hook` entry from `.claude/settings.json`
the flag printed nothing in 3.0 and is gone, so `doctor --from` now exits 1 naming it; instead: `basalt-ui migrate --from <x.y.z> --profile <profile>`, beside the version rows of MIGRATING.md
waivers have no ceiling in 3.0: a full `basalt-ui lint` records the count in `.basalt/budget.json`, so a new waiver shows in the diff; `lint --raise escapes --consumer` stays for the escapes ceiling
the sheet is the one output and `--check` compares it alone; delete the committed `basalt.tokens.css.d.ts`, which only augmented the removed series slot
